### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-datasource`, touching **22** documentable anchor(s).

**21** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4860da151df014ef093c87d6517d78d92b009d9`.

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **28** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4860da151df014ef093c87d6517d78d92b009d9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0c517c4616ad08325a426cf7cf6c2792d0a701ea` — the merge of head `f3e50da5f457813415390a24b0daa84085e2cb05` into base `f4860da151df014ef093c87d6517d78d92b009d9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0c517c4616ad08325a426cf7cf6c2792d0a701ea && git checkout 0c517c4616ad08325a426cf7cf6c2792d0a701ea
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f4860da151df014ef093c87d6517d78d92b009d9 f3e50da5f457813415390a24b0daa84085e2cb05 && git checkout -B drift-repro f4860da151df014ef093c87d6517d78d92b009d9 && git merge --no-ff f3e50da5f457813415390a24b0daa84085e2cb05

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4860da151df014ef093c87d6517d78d92b009d9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f4860da151df014ef093c87d6517d78d92b009d9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f3e50da5f457813415390a24b0daa84085e2cb05`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-delete-unknown-flow.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-runs-unknown-flow.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-draft-doors-unknown-package.test.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-route-ledger.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-admin-service.test.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-unknown-name.test.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/envelope.conformance.test.ts + packages/runtime/src/flow-dispatch-status.ts (`flowIsUnknown`, `flowNotFoundMessage`, `FLOW_NOT_FOUND_STATUS`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (`publishPackageDrafts` / `discardPackageDrafts` result shapes), packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts (`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, 404)

Face: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on the PR body and the changeset; no published schema and no governed path in the diff. Read: the net diff, card #25486, the PR body, the check-runs on `f3e50da5f`.

### ① Derived judgments

Eight REST doors narrow their served set for a resource that does not exist; each now answers what its read sibling already answered for the same name. Per door:

- `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts`: 404 only when the protocol answered `nothing_to_publish`, nothing was un-hidden, no `unhideError` was recorded, and the registry lacks the id. `packageIsUnknown` uses the same `registry.getPackage` that `GET /packages/:id` answers its 404 from, and answers `false` when the registry cannot be asked. Drafts held for an unregistered id still publish. Right, and the failed-flip guard is the correct order (a failed flip proves nothing about absence).
- `POST /packages/:id/discard-drafts`: 404 when `discardedCount === 0 && failedCount === 0` and the registry lacks the id. `discardPackageDrafts` does return `failedCount` (verified in `protocol.ts`), so the guard is live in production, not only under the test stub. Right.
- `GET /packages/:id/commits`: 404 when the trail is empty and the registry lacks the id; an orphan trail is still served. Right.
- `GET /automation/:name/runs`: `flowIsUnknown` asked first, the trigger door's own probe and message (`flow-dispatch-status.ts`, already imported in `automation.ts`), so runs and trigger cannot disagree. A service without `getFlow` lists as before. Right.
- `DELETE /automation/:name`: 404 only when the engine did not hold it AND the store deleted no row (`reset !== true`); a stored-only flow is still deleted. Right; the asymmetry with the engine-only probes is deliberate and recorded (trade-off c).
- `PATCH` / `DELETE /datasources/:name`, `POST .../migrate-credential`: the producer (`DatasourceAdminService`) throws `datasourceNotFoundError` carrying `code: 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'`, `status: 404`, with GET's words `Datasource "NAME" does not exist.`; `badRequest` in `admin-routes.ts` relays that envelope exactly as it already relays the 503. `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` ↔ 404 is in the standard ledger. A code-defined datasource keeps `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`. Right.
- Unchanged for a resource that exists: empty runs page, `nothing_to_publish`, empty commit trail, `200 { deleted: true }` for a stored flow. The `external-datasource` by-name doors are left as they are, with the reason recorded. Right.
- Public surface: no new error code, no schema change, no metadata key. `DatasourceAdminService` embedders see a typed envelope and a changed message, stated in the changeset.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/service-datasource`, title `fix(rest)!:`, **BREAKING** section with the per-door before/after, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in body and changeset, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Correct for a non-protocol served-set narrowing (AGENTS.md step 3). One note, not blocking: the changeset summary line reads `fix(rest):` without the bang while the title carries it; the gate reads the BREAKING banner as the declaration, and the Clause-② line is present, so the declaration is whole. Check-runs on `f3e50da5f`: CI, Lint & Type Check, Governed Surface Guard, Docs Drift Check, Check Links, the four claim guards, PR Automation all `success`; Pack Smoke and Upgrade Harness `skipped` (opt-in). The PR Automation `failure` sits on the superseded head `a2f19a47eb` only.

### ③ Boundary flags

- (a) Orphan commit trail still `200`; `GET /:name/runs/:runId` still answers by run id alone → accepted; absence of the package is not absence of the trail.
- (b) A draft-only flow (stored, not registered) now gets 404 at `GET /:name/runs` → accepted; it is the trigger door's definition of "exists", and objectui `FlowRunsPanel` renders the rejection. Not a protocol face.
- (c) DELETE counts store-or-engine existence while runs/trigger/GET count the engine only → accepted; it keeps a flow that failed to register deletable.
- Datasource not-found message changed to GET's words → not a contract face; pins flipped in the same PR.
- `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.outcome` describe still says `nothing_to_publish` = no pending drafts → still true at the protocol; the REST door answers before the protocol is reached for an unknown package. No spec text change needed.
- Dogfood battery owed by the arm → counts pinned to `f3e50da5f` are in the seat record 6386121090 (no failure). Accepted as reported; not re-run here.
- No `open_questions` entry on the card.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-25486-unknown-resource-404`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Bf4vhia9fHNXpqC1PCfxie`

**VERDICT: PASS**

`needs:contract-review` removed in this stroke. Landing (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`) stays with the `domain:server` seat; the record governs this head only.
